spans.s: --a son of ज्योतिष्मत् after whom came the रथाकार kingdom (a part of the कुशद्वीप). Br. II. १४. २७; Vi.
--a R. sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ६४.
--detachment and devotion to ज्ञानम्; leads to purification of body and mind. One such person becomes a निर्मम। Br.
(II)--a प्रजापति, whose पितृस् are formless. M. १३. 3.
(IV)--the २७थ् kalpa;^1 (१९थ् kalpa-वा। प्।); the period of वैराज Manu, son of the Creator. M. २९०. १०; वा. २१. ४०-2; Br.
(VI)--father of नद्वला; a progenitor and father-in-law of sixth Manu. Vi. I. १३. 4.
(VII)--also a वीरपुरुष from whom was born शतरूपा and two sons Priyavrata and उत्तानपाद as also two daughters आकूती and प्रसूती. वा. १०. १५-7.

(I)--the first gods created by ब्रह्मा to occupy the first worlds by name सम्तानकस्; among them seven groups are distinguished, three formless and four with form; then earth, rains, food, worship of moon for rice; the formless attain absolution through yoga power;
1: Br.

. ५२-62; वा. ७१. ५२.
the three formless groups are पितृस् engaged in yoga;
2: Br. III. १०. 4.
ऋभु and Sanat- कुमार come under this class; they attained Brahmaloka or siddhi.
3: Ib.

(II)--a class of formless पितृस्: Fallen from Yoga, they attain eternal worlds (लोकान् sana1tana1n) and are reborn as ब्रह्मवादिन्स् at the end of a day of ब्रह्मा: they then gain their old memory and by सान्ख्य and yoga they attain final release. Their mind-born daughter मेना is the wife of हिमवान्. M. १
(III)--the Brahmans living in the Virajasa world; this is said to be the first Kalpa of the वैराजास्. वा. ७२. 4; १०१. ६१-4.

--(see वैराजास्): performers of austerities; stand ten times until आभूतसम्प्लव, after Pralaya, enter- ing प्रणव aimed at Brahmaloka through Yogadharma and attained the आनन्द of ब्रह्मा; six characteristics of; deprived of three भावस् (body, mind and speech) do not regard द्वन्द्व (sukha duhkha, etc.); reach बुद्धावस्था. वा. १०१. ३७, ७१, ८०, ८१, १४०. [page३-337+ २५]
--a सूक्तम् of the साम Samhita1 to be recit- ed in the ritual associated with the digging of a tank. M. ५८. ३६.
--one of the wives of दक्ष, mother of
--created from the west face of ब्रह्मा. Vi.

. ५२.
helped सुप्रतीक elephant to get सारूप्यम्।
3: Ib.
